description: What a public source says has happened to a land banking site since its award, for awards the development ledger cannot place on its own. Read by scripts/funding/build_land_banking_status.py. A 'partner' or 'seeking' entry needs https sources, each with a date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), and a verbatim quote; a 'none_found' entry records that the award was searched for (council and housing-authority pages, local news, CHFA applicant reports) on its checked date and nothing public was found. Never name a private developer in 'text': the source link carries the name.

fy23-24-city-of-grand-junction-salt-flat.text: The city closed on the 21.78-acre site in January 2025 and picked development teams for it later that year. One partner applied for 2026 4% tax credits for 62 senior and veteran rental homes on part of the site (Haven at Salt Flats); CHFA has not announced that round.

sources.title: City of Grand Junction, Ordinance 5275 (closing 9 Jan 2025)

fy23-24-city-of-grand-junction-salt-flat.quote: Name: Haven at Salt Flats; Address: 450 28 Road; City: Grand Junction; Total Units: 62; LI Units: 62

fy25-26-rural-rivergate-lot-5-workforce-.text: The city chose a development partner in October 2025, after a search it opened in June 2025, for about 31 workforce homes on the 1.7-acre Rivergate lot. The city plans to give the land to the partner once agreed milestones are met.
fy25-26-rural-rivergate-lot-5-workforce-.quote: In June 2025, the City launched a search to find a development partner. ... In exchange for developing the lot, the City intends to donate the land to the developer, provided agreed-upon milestones are met.

fy23-24-salida-eastside-senior-living-ap.text: The city bought the 2.6-acre site at 507 Scott Street in May 2025 and contracted a development partner after a July 2025 request for proposals. Its February 2026 application for 9% tax credits (40 senior homes) was not selected; the city plans to apply again in early 2027.

sources.title: City of Salida, Scott Street project page

fy23-24-salida-eastside-senior-living-ap.quote: was not selected ... resubmit again in the next grant cycle in early 2027

fy25-26-rural-leadville-railyards.text: The grantee and a developer partner plan Alpenglow Commons, 44 apartments at 1201 Poplar Street in the Railyard neighborhood. In June 2026 the next steps were planning and zoning meetings; the design was not final.
fy25-26-rural-leadville-railyards.quote: The building is planned to be two to three stories, housing 44 apartments ... The next steps will be planning and zoning meetings, where they will need to request a density easement
